# Third-party baseline code

Unmodified algorithm files from the authors' repositories, each with its original license.
The adapters in `prier/baselines/` import these files and only replace data loading,
configuration and the oracle (our local reviewer with a token budget).

| Directory | Source | Commit | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kwikbucks/` | [google-research/kwikbucks](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/5b09c22d73a9d35eb6c5d2a99b95677a45053466/kwikbucks) | `5b09c22` | Apache-2.0 |
| `alper/` | [HKBU-LAGAS/Alper](https://github.com/HKBU-LAGAS/Alper/tree/d4151ee5ce3ac7dabf377ffe2dc3877ad9b965fd) | `d4151ee` | MIT |
| `acc/` | [Linusaronsson/Active-Correlation-Clustering](https://github.com/Linusaronsson/Active-Correlation-Clustering/tree/313d989df570437d0b004e1e8a0f354a750fbe62) | `313d989` | Apache-2.0 |
